outcome_data_inspected_before_freeze_not: This prereg was frozen before any contagion, lead-lag, Granger, permutation, funding-tercile, or temporal-stability statistic was computed. The only prior inspection was metadata/coverage (row counts, null fractions, timestamp ranges, per-coin event counts, panel sha256) required to make the design executable. No target distribution, edge weight, causality p-value, or network metric was observed.
repository_name_priority: The repository is named Funding-conditioned-volatility-and-liquidation-risk, which mandates three pillars: funding-conditioned, volatility, liquidation risk. No campaign to date has joined all three. FCLR-LIQ-CONTAGION-001 is the first: it tests whether liquidations in coin A predict liquidations in coin B (liquidation risk), whether funding rate differentials between coins modulate that cross-coin prediction (funding-conditioned), and whether realized volatility in one coin predicts liquidations in another (volatility).

combined_liquidation_panel.null_notes: fundingRate, abs_fund_pct, notional_usd, rv24h, rv168h are non-null on all 1,740,415 rows. premium is present but not required by this protocol.

hypotheses.directional_claim: Liquidation intensity in coin A at hour t predicts liquidation intensity in coin B at hour t+k (k=1..24h), after controlling for coin B's own past liquidations and market-wide liquidation activity, for a material subset of directed (A->B) pairs.
hypotheses.estimand: Granger-causality F-statistic / p-value of coin-A liquidation count in a VAR of coin-B hourly liquidation count, on hourly aggregated counts; lead-lag cross-correlation at lags 1..24h.
hypotheses.materiality_definition: Contagion effect must explain >= 2% of the variance in coin B's liquidations (equivalently the lead-lag/Granger signal must clear a 2% relative effect floor) to be material. Frozen; not relaxed after outcomes.

hypotheses.directional_claim: The funding rate differential between coins modulates contagion strength: when funding(A) > funding(B) + threshold, liquidations in A more strongly predict liquidations in B (funding-mediated spillover).
hypotheses.estimand: Funding-tercile (low/medium/high differential) stratified contagion network; monotonicity of edge weights with funding differential; interaction term funding_diff x lagged_liquidation_A in the coin-B intensity regression.
hypotheses.materiality_definition: Funding modulation must produce a >= 2% relative difference in edge weight / effect between high- and low-differential terciles to be material. Frozen; not relaxed after outcomes.

network_construction.graph: 15x15 directed graph; edge A->B present if Granger causality p < 0.01 after Bonferroni correction for 210 directed tests (alpha_adj = 0.01/210).
network_construction.edge_weight: Granger F-statistic or maximum absolute lead-lag correlation coefficient across lags 1..24h.
network_construction.permutation_test: 1000+ time-series permutations per directed pair for a null distribution of edge weights; empirical p-value = fraction of null weights >= observed weight.

funding_conditioning.split: Funding rate differential between coin pairs split into terciles (low / medium / high).
funding_conditioning.within_tercile: Recompute the contagion network (Granger + lead-lag) within each funding-differential tercile.
funding_conditioning.monotonicity_test: Test whether edge weights increase monotonically with funding differential across terciles.
funding_conditioning.interaction: Interaction term funding_diff x lagged liquidation of source coin in target-coin intensity regression.

temporal_stability.design: Rolling window: 90-day windows, 30-day step, over the full panel span.
temporal_stability.reported: Network density over time, edge persistence (fraction of windows an edge is significant), regime-dependent contagion.
temporal_stability.windows: Pre-registered; boundaries derived from panel timestamp span only.

hourly_aggregation.rule: Collapse the event-level combined liquidation panel to (coin, UTC floor-hour) by count of events and sum of notional_usd. Build the COMPLETE hourly grid over each coin's observed span so zero-event hours are explicit zeros (flagged has_event=False; not silently fabricated). Funding predictor for an hour = mean of fundingRate across events inside that hour; for zero-event hours funding is carried from the most recent prior in-panel funding observation (forward fill of FUNDING only, never of the outcome), flagged funding_is_ffill=True. Hours with no prior funding are dropped and counted.
hourly_aggregation.inputs: notional_usd (count + sum), fundingRate (hourly mean), rv24h, rv168h (hourly, carried forward within coin), mark/ema_dist (hourly).

inference.primary_se: Permutation-based empirical p-values (1000+ permutations) for each directed pair and edge weight.
inference.multiple_testing: Bonferroni correction across 210 directed Granger tests; Holm familywise correction across the declared hypothesis family; raw and adjusted p-values both reported.
inference.block_bootstrap: Block bootstrap across contiguous UTC time blocks (jointly across coins) to preserve common market shocks and serial dependence; deterministic seed; sensitivity to leave-one-coin-out reported.

support_requires_H_contagion_liq: At least one directed (A->B) edge significant at Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.01 across the 210 pairs
Lead-lag / Granger signal clears the 2% relative materiality floor
Not dominated by a single coin or a single time block
support_requires_H_contagion_funding: Edge weight / effect increases monotonically with funding-differential tercile (low < medium < high)
Interaction term significant after multiplicity correction
>= 2% relative difference between high- and low-differential terciles

hard_constraints_honored: panel sha256 asserted in eval script header before any read
no random train/test split; strictly chronological
materiality floor 0.02 frozen and not relaxed after outcomes
observed liquidations kept distinct from modeled boundary breaches (Track A observed events only)
no external trigger required; frozen panel is the sole input
no network, no paid data, no credentials
no root-level research_state/*.md|*.json added (root churn cap 499/500 respected)
